blocks.html:
This method removes users from an RBAC role. It sends a request to the
Remove Role Users API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The users to remove from the role.

children.name: users
children.description: The IDs of the users to remove from the role.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: ids
children.description: The IDs of the users that were removed.

children.name: object
children.description: The type of the removed items.

children.name: deleted
children.description: Whether the users were removed successfully.
